skill.summary: Generate professional PDF resumes and cover letters via the useresume.ai API. Supports creating, tailoring (AI-optimized for a job), and parsing documents.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of useresume skill.

- Generate professional PDF resumes and cover letters via the useresume.ai API.
- Supports resume and cover letter creation, AI-tailored outputs, and document parsing to structured or plain text formats.
- Robust command-line interface with JSON-based inputs and outputs.
- Requires API key and Node.js installation of the CLI.
- Includes commands for credentials testing, retrieving job status, and flexible document styling options.
